scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT supercell energies is infeasible because raw total energy files are not submitted; the agent's computed transition levels and formation energies are compared to paper-reported values with tolerances that accommodate expected PBE implementation differences.

outputs.description: Transition energy levels of V_I and I_i defects on outer (LA) and inner (LB) layers.
Neutral formation energies (μ_i=0) of deep defects Pb_i, Pb_I, I_M, I_Pb.

output_contract.notes: The agent must compute these quantities using PBE DFT without spin-orbit coupling. The hidden reference values are derived from the paper's reported results for the 2D1L system.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold transition levels and formation energies for 2D1L perovskite.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 812479741532569600, Section 3.2: transition levels for V_I and I_i on LA and LB layers, and formation energies of deep defects Pb_i, Pb_I, I_M, I_Pb at μ_i=0.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper text and cross-checked with reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are those published in the paper; no invention.
